search_updates.claim: male same-sex conduct criminalised up to 2 years under Article 135
search_updates.found: CONFIRMED current: male homosexuality illegal (Art. 135, Criminal Code 1997 as amended 13 Nov 2021) — up to 2 years deprivation of liberty, with labour-camp terms of 2-5 years possible; only other post-Soviet state criminalising alongside Uzbekistan; a Feb 2021 announced decriminalisation plan was never enacted; investigations reportedly humiliating/torture-prone.
